svg.title: GenoPredict Genomic Variant MLOps Project Workflow
svg.desc: End-to-end workflow diagram for the genomic variant MLOps project, including data versioning, processing, training, governance, serving, frontend, monitoring, deployment, and CI/CD technologies.
svg.text: End-to-end schema: data versioning, feature engineering, XGBoost training, MLflow governance, FastAPI serving, React UI, monitoring, and Docker deployment.
Main commands: python run_pipeline.py | python run_api.py | docker compose up --build
Raw genomic files are managed locally and through DVC/S3 so training can be reproduced.
The root launcher orchestrates sequential Prefect tasks, while each step lives in src/ modules.
The API loads the Production model from MLflow, enforces the same feature contract, and serves predictions to the UI.
4. Monitoring, Drift, and Product Feedback Loop
Operational metrics and prediction events feed dashboards and drift reports after real API usage.
Docker Compose runs the full stack, while GitHub Actions verifies tests, frontend build, and compose images.

g.text: dvc pull when data is missing
used by training and API lookup
AWS credentials when remote data is needed
DuckDB S3 bridge if local miss
manual SIFT, PolyPhen, CADD, ALT_FREQ if needed
Nginx or Vite proxy for /api and /metrics
single prediction and VCF Lab pages
Python 3.11 tests, npm ci, frontend build, docker compose config, compose build
pytest smoke tests cover health, single prediction, VCF upload, batch prediction, feature lookup
